## Checklist

- [ ] **No binaries.** No `.dll`, `.exe`, or `.addon64` files — especially not `nvngx_dlssnr.dll`.
      This project never distributes NVIDIA runtimes, and a binary in a PR will be declined.
- [ ] **No download links** for the neural runtime, mirrors, or file-host archives.
      Linking an official project's own releases page is fine.
- [ ] If this adds a game result, it includes the **proof line from a log** rather than
      "it worked for me".
- [ ] The game involved is **single-player with no anti-cheat**.
